Title: [Deck] "Waiter, there is a Vampire in my soup..."

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
Ok, basically what this deck is desigend to do is have other Vampires for
dinner.
When in combat, the vampire uses the Bonespur for aggro damage followed by
Amaranth to
eat 'em up. If/when there is a Bloodhunt called, the Gangrel Conspiracy is
used to show that
the Gangrel AntiTribes answer to no one. The Parthenon is in there so I
can have a Master action
even after using the MOoT (the Conspiracy).
If any of the regular Gangrels put the opponent into torpor, then the G:AT
will just come in behind them and clean up the mess. If blocked, then
it'll be the blocking vamp that get's eaten.
Pretty straightforward and *very* evil.

Any suggestions on how to improve the deck will be welcome.
